title: chore(core): migrate core file to TS
body:
**Summary**

migrated the InstantSearch.js file to TypeScript to have better inference in other places

**Result**

* main.ts & InstantSearch.ts are now in typescript
* mocked version of InstantSearch now has all other properties that weren't mocked before
  * including deferred functions which were previously implemented as just a jest.fn, meaning some change in tests

this depends on:

* \[x] https://github.com/DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped/pull/37105
* \[x] https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/pull/739
